question: Can support-preserving compressed beliefs be used without invalidating legal observations, and what is their decision/cost tradeoff on fresh addressed worlds?
scope: Finite R15 owner, frozen R15 fitted models and selections, new deterministic state approximations. R16 auxiliary studies have separate scopes and protocols. No result substitutes for a failed primary D-B gate.
A: Previously selected ordinary law + previously selected fixed pattern
B: Same ordinary law + unchanged R15 finite-query value controller
C: Previously fitted HX law + same fixed pattern
D: Same HX law + unchanged R15 finite-query value controller
hmm_same_matrix: Independently restored exact same HX matrices with ordinary HMM label; full runtime charged
compression: Apply each projection after every propagation and observation in both owner belief and planner; world, observations, costs and fitted law remain unchanged
fitted_inputs: R15 run_01/calibration/*.json.gz and run_01/FREEZE.json are reused verbatim at the baseline SHA; no new fitting or selection using R16 worlds
execution: One shared Gillespie world per episode; actor order deterministically shuffled per episode; all nine arms must complete. Partial runs remain raw failures and do not yield a success-only contrast.
archive: 8 episodes per immutable gzip shard, preserving full owner tape and per-query actions/targets/fees/checkpoint digests; failed in-progress episode retains its world and completed actor prefixes, plus failure and process receipts

statistics.independent_unit: Eight inherited independent fitted seeds, each evaluated on fresh worlds; not 6144 independent queries
statistics.primary: D-B in both domains: mean >=0.01, t95 lower>0, exhaustive two-sided sign-flip Holm-adjusted p<0.05
statistics.secondary: A/B/C/D simple effects and interaction; D minus each compression are descriptive paired seed contrasts
statistics.compression_quality: All 12 one-sided Bonferroni t lower bounds for compression-D utility/reward x three compressions x two domains must exceed -0.01
statistics.compression_cost: Each domain online CPU and preparation plus checkpoint plus 1000-use CPU ratio to D <=0.90, only after quality guard
statistics.no_rescue: Auxiliary numerical, content, reset or witness evidence cannot pass the primary gate

cost: Record each actor online CPU including planner branches and six diagnostic checkpoint captures, its cold restoration and checkpoint encode/decode CPU, every world-generation CPU, compression storage bytes, process elapsed/CPU and archive I/O. All arms run the same audited execution path; this is not optimized production latency. Inherited training cost remains separately attributed to R15 and cannot be interpreted as new current-host training timing.
source_freeze: Publish source, protocol, exact inherited model hashes and all failed development attempts before fresh main confirmation; verify local hashes against freeze; output requires frozen commit identifier
development: Separate namespace 916 and at most two worlds per domain per development fit; never pooled with confirmation
